title: Maximum Sum Window
statement:
Given an integer array `nums` and an integer `k`, return the largest sum of any contiguous subarray of exactly `k` elements.

### Input
- Line 1: `n`
- Line 2: `n` integers, the elements of `nums`
- Line 3: `k`

### Output
One integer, the maximum window sum.

### Constraints
- 1 ≤ k ≤ n < 10⁵
- −10⁹ ≤ nums[i] ≤ 10⁹ (the answer needs 64-bit integers)
